A rider travels this weekend from Delancey St-Essex St to Franklin St using only the services and free transfers shown on this map. If more than one service runs between the same two stations on a leg, any of them is accepted. Answer as a JSON list of route letters or numbers, for example ["A", "7"].

Answer the question using the image. Think it through, then give the answer as a JSON list of names exactly as written on the map, in order, e.g. ["A", "7"].
End your reply with a final line of the form:
FINAL ANSWER: <answer>

No single service links Delancey to the 1 line, and the 2 and 3 can't be used between Park Place and Wall St this weekend, so two transfers is the minimum. The J-R-1 path is the one I found with two transfers; I did not exhaustively check every alternative for the fewest stops.
